answers.core: It seems an important core feature that should be enabled by default since it would be useful to any C# project that is using signals.
answers.workaround: Code analysers can be disabled [easily](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/code-quality/in-source-suppression-overview?view=vs-2022&tabs=csharp) with a SuppressMessageAttribute or with more broadly with EditorConfig files but I'm not sure why somebody would want to suppress this particular one
